help.title: Help & Support

booking.question: How do I book a table?
booking.answer: Open a place, tap Book a Table, then pick the day, time and number of guests. To choose a table yourself, tap it on the place's photo first; otherwise the venue assigns one. You need to be logged in with a confirmed phone number. Some places do not take bookings in the app.

code.question: Why do I get a code by SMS?
code.answer: The code confirms the phone number is yours, so a venue can reach you about your booking. If it does not arrive, wait a moment and ask for a new one.

table.question: How does the code on the table work?
table.answer: Scan the QR code on your table to open a tab, or to join the one already open. No account is needed. If someone opened the tab before you, they approve you on their phone.

reviews.question: Why can’t I leave a review?
reviews.answer: Reviews are for real visits: a booking you were seated for, or a tab you were on at that place, in the last 180 days. You also need a confirmed phone number. Reviews are public and show your first name and an initial.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Go to Profile and tap Delete account. Your reviews, profile photo, favorites and notifications are deleted. Venues keep their own record of your past bookings and orders, no longer linked to an account.

favorites.question: Where are my favorites saved?
favorites.answer: When you are logged in, favorites are saved to your account, so they are there on any phone you log in on. Hearts you tap while logged out stay on this phone and move to your account when you log in.

venuesSee.question: What do venues see about my bookings?
venuesSee.answer: Only the numbers, never where. A venue you book with sees how many of your bookings in the last 12 months, at all venues, you kept, missed or cancelled late, and how many were not marked. If you miss three bookings in three days, you can't book for a week and your bookings that had not started are cancelled; while that lasts, venues see it too. If a venue marked you as a no-show by mistake, contact that venue.
